title: Cost warning — written update
situation: In a technical discussion, a manager asks whether a budget guarantees zero overspend. You must write the decision accurately without overstating the evidence.
instructions: Write four sentences on what a budget alert actually does, its delay, and the control that would genuinely cap spending.

vocabulary.meaning: a limit that is enforced rather than observed, as opposed to an alert that only reports after the fact
the time between a spend occurring and the alert firing, during which spending continues unchecked

expectedElements: The difference between alerting and enforcing is made
A genuine capping control is proposed
modelAnswer: A budget does not prevent overspend; it reports it. It observes accumulated cost and notifies when a threshold is crossed, and the notification arrives with a delay of several hours during which spending continues. A real cap has to be enforced on the resource, or automated so that crossing the threshold shuts the resource down. The evidence is the alert history alongside the invoice for the same period, which makes the gap visible.
commonMistakes: Confirming the assumption instead of correcting it
Correcting it without proposing a control that actually caps spending
variants: Rewrite the update to propose the automation and its failure mode.
